scenes.headline: How self-attention lets every token look at every other
scenes.sub: Queries, keys, values, a softmax, and why the √d scaling matters
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Garnet! Self-attention is how a transformer decides which other tokens are worth listening to. Here's the whole operation.

scenes.text: Give every token three learned vectors, a query, a key and a value, and let each token look at all the others in one parallel step.
scenes.say: Give every token three learned vectors: a query, a key and a value. Then every token can look at all the others, in one parallel step.

left.title: An RNN
items: Squeezes the sentence through a fixed-size hidden state
left.say: An RNN squeezes the whole sentence through a fixed-size hidden state, reading left to right.

right.title: Self-attention
items: Every token looks directly at every other
And learns how much to look
right.say: Attention drops that bottleneck. Every token looks straight at every other, and learns how much to look.

steps.say: Multiply each embedding by three learned matrices. The query asks what am I looking for. The key says what I'm about. The value is the content.
Compare a query with every key by a dot product. When the two point the same way, the score is big.
A softmax turns the scores into weights, and the output blends the values by those weights.

scenes.title: The whole operation, in one line
scenes.say: That one line is the whole operation.

parts.note: every query against every key: a grid of raw scores
parts.say: Q times K transposed scores every pair of tokens.

parts.note: keeps big dot products from saturating the softmax
parts.say: Dividing by the square root of the key size keeps the softmax from saturating, so gradients keep flowing.

parts.note: each row becomes weights that sum to one
parts.say: Softmax turns each row into weights that sum to one.

parts.note: read out a weighted average of the values
parts.say: And multiplying by V reads out a weighted mix of values.

scenes.text: Everything else in a transformer exists to support and stack this one operation.
scenes.say: Stack several heads side by side, repeat across depth, and you have a transformer. Everything else exists to support and stack this one operation.

recap: Queries ask, keys advertise, values carry content
Scaled dot products, softmaxed into weights
scenes.say: To recap: queries ask, keys answer, values carry the content, and the square root scaling keeps it all trainable.
